protocol.scope: Every completed round in the complete 17-route archived online-LLM portfolio.
protocol.probability_endpoint: Whether the executed candidate strictly improves the best target outcome revealed before that round.
protocol.llm_probability: The final proposer-critic decision field probability_of_improving_current_best.
protocol.gp_probability: The production GP probability of improvement for the same executed candidate in the hidden-outcome candidate menu.
protocol.legacy_gp_probability_reconstruction: If an archived menu predates the explicit GP probability field, reconstruct Phi((posterior_mean-current_best)/posterior_std), matching the production Gaussian probability-of-improvement formula.
protocol.claim_boundary: This audit measures retrospective probability calibration on archived decisions. It is not a prospective gate evaluation and does not establish scientific reasoning quality or transfer efficacy.
